title: Signed receipt v2
description: Receipt v1's fields plus issued_at, the time it was signed, made from its event by receiptOfV2, and an Ed25519 signature over its canonical form (keys sorted, JSON). A verifier checks issued_at against the signing key's window; the school's books make the same receipt again from the same event and issued_at.

key.description: The family's timeline, e.g. family:fam_8k2. No name or email.

amount.description: Cents: amount_paid on a payment, amount on a refund.

stripe_id.description: The invoice id (a booking's payment intent) on a payment, the payload's id on a refund.

event_hash.description: sha256 (hex) of the event's canonical form.

issued_at.description: When the receipt was signed, RFC 3339 UTC. Signed, so a key's window can be checked; a revoked key fails whatever it says.

sig.description: Ed25519 over the receipt's canonical form, base64url without padding.
